**Failure mode:** Missing data (taxonomy 5), with the Agent filling the gap by inventing a substitute. The run reports `completed` only because nothing crashed. The outcome is wrong.

**Where it went wrong:** Step 2 of the AOP says to open "Carrier rate card 2026.xlsx" in Files. The search at [1]–[2] returned nothing. The AOP has no branch for that case, so at [3] the Agent switched to "typical market rates," a benchmark the AOP never mentions. At [4] it compared the invoice lines against that benchmark, found nothing above 3%, and reported that no lines were flagged. The 3% rule in Step 3 was applied to a reference the AOP doesn't define.

**Evidence:**
> [2] Tool result ← files.search: {"results": []}
> [3] Agent: The rate card isn't available. I'll compare against typical market rates for these lanes instead.

The transcript also has no tool call that reads the invoice lines (Step 1), so the "all lines are within typical market range" claim at [4] isn't backed by any visible review of the invoice.

**Fix:** Add a stop condition to Step 2 of the AOP: *"If 'Carrier rate card 2026.xlsx' is not found in Files, do not compare against any other rates. Fail the case with the reason 'rate card missing' and do not append to Google Sheets."* This makes the Run fail visibly instead of writing a clean-looking audit row. Before rerunning, also confirm the file is actually in Files under that exact name. An empty search can mean the file was never uploaded, was renamed (spacing, year, or extension), or isn't visible to this Agent.

**Next step:** This fix belongs in the AOP, so I'd hand it to `aop-writer` with Build `bld_d01` and the change request above. Separately, the Google Sheets row written at [5]–[6] (`flags: []`) is a false negative in the audit log. Someone should review or remove it, since it currently says the freight invoice was checked against a rate card that was never opened.
